savings.explanationDetail:
Each cigarette costs €{{prixCig}} (pack price ÷ cigarettes per pack).
{{count}} × €{{prixCig}} × 30 days = €{{ecoMois}} per month.
savings.note: You can adjust the pack price in Profile → Consumption settings.

lifeMonth.explanation_one:
Medical studies estimate that one cigarette reduces life expectancy by about 5 minutes.

By avoiding {{count}} cigarette a day, you gain back {{minutes}} minutes of life every day, or about {{hours}}h per month.
lifeMonth.explanation_other:
Medical studies estimate that one cigarette reduces life expectancy by about 5 minutes.

By avoiding {{count}} cigarettes a day, you gain back {{minutes}} minutes of life every day, or about {{hours}}h per month.

lifeYear.explanation_one:
Over a full year, the 5 minutes gained per cigarette avoided add up:

{{count}} cigarette avoided × 5 min × 365 days = about {{days}} days of life expectancy gained every year.
lifeYear.explanation_other:
Over a full year, the 5 minutes gained per cigarette avoided add up:

{{count}} cigarettes avoided × 5 min × 365 days = about {{days}} days of life expectancy gained every year.

health.label: health
health.explanation:
Your body starts repairing itself as soon as you cut back:

• 20 min: blood pressure returns to normal
• 8 h: carbon monoxide in your blood drops by half
• 24 h: heart attack risk starts to decrease
• 48 h: taste and smell improve
• 72 h: breathing becomes easier
• 1 year: stroke risk matches that of a non-smoker
health.note: Find your detailed health progress on the dashboard.
